input.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>json-app</artifactId>
    <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <name>json-app</name>
    <description>Maven project that parses and generates JSON with Jackson</description>

    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.release>17</maven.compiler.release>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <jackson.version>2.17.2</jackson.version>
        <junit.version>5.10.2</junit.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.fasterxml.jackson.core</groupId>
            <artifactId>jackson-databind</artifactId>
            <version>${jackson.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>${junit.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.13.0</version>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.2.5</version>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.3</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>shade</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <transformers>
                                <transformer implementation="org.apache.maven.plugins.shade.resource.ManifestResourceTransformer">
                                    <mainClass>com.example.jsonapp.JsonApp</mainClass>
                                </transformer>
                            </transformers>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

Maven project created and verified (`mvn clean verify` passes, 3 tests green, runnable jar works).

- `pom.xml` — Java 17, Jackson `jackson-databind` 2.17.2, JUnit 5, shade plugin for a runnable uber-jar
- `src/main/java/com/example/jsonapp/Person.java` — record model
- `src/main/java/com/example/jsonapp/JsonApp.java` — `toJson()` / `fromJson()` using `ObjectMapper`
- `src/test/java/com/example/jsonapp/JsonAppTest.java` — generate/parse/round-trip tests
- `.gitignore` — ignores `target/` and IDE files

Run it:
```bash
mvn clean package
java -jar target/json-app-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar
```

Note: `mvn`/`java` aren't installed in this environment, so I used a JDK 17 + Maven 3.9.9 downloaded to `/tmp/opencode` to verify. You'll need them on `PATH` to build locally.
